text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened one afternoon on a day off—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Aaah!? I got so hyped up with 
self-training that I totally skipped 
lunch, did I not~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if I go to the cafeteria now, I won't 
make it in time... ...Wait, am I skipping 
a meal today!? Am I the Lunchless Princess 
now~?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no need to worry! Your lunch is right 
here!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is a Hidaka Wagyu Yakiniku Bento... 
Made generously with A5-rank beef, it's 
the perfect boxed meal for after training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you quite sure!? Thank you ever so 
much, Miss Pearl!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman. You must eat your lunch.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing!? However! Not until I finish 
this athletic course proposal—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, eat this. It's an onigiri 
bento with octopus and sea bream rice!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? With this, I can eat while working!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is bad... Even though it's 
mealtime, I just can't work up an appetite 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, it's super easy to eat— how 
about a seafood dashi chazuke bento!?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ohoo!? T-This smell is— the scent of 
Kansai dashi from back home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly appears, hands out a bento, 
and leaves. Seeking the Pearl's recent 
antics have earned her the nickname "Bento 
Hero" around town, or so they sayâ
choice_data_list:
...Ah. Come to think of it, I haven't 
eaten lunch—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't worry. I've already prepared 
our boxed lunches. A classic Makunouchi 
bento with barrel-shaped rice balls, of 
course.
choice_data_list: ...Why do you act as the Bento Hero?
...Why do you act as the Bento Hero?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~, great question. Of course, spreading 
the wonder of bento is part of it, but—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Pushing yourself so hard you put off 
eating... That spirit is very good, yes.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But you know. Food Is Life. You can't just 
neglect it by saying "I'm too busy, so it 
can't be helped."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... I will eradicate "it can't be 
helped"! That is my mission as the one 
chosen to make this lunch!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Heh. Finished handing them out for today—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrumble~~~~...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, very mistake! To think I would skip 
a meal myself...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In that case! We shall prepare the boxed 
lunches!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Here's that jumbo fried chicken I bought 
earlier for a snack! Please, eat up!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Presenting a souvenir from my business 
trip: self-heating shumai! You can enjoy 
it piping hot!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We've got takoyaki and okonomiyaki 
too! I brought food along!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those who had been saved by the Bento Hero 
all gathered together, each bringing an 
ingredient— and completed the ultimate 
variety bento!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...! E-Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's feelings—packed tightly into 
this lunchbox, shining with all the colors 
of the rainbow...!
choice_data_list:
That's the result of working as a hero, 
huh.

That's the result of working as a hero, 
you know.

This is... the bond forged by boxed 
lunches...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's feelings—packed tightly into 
this lunchbox, shining with all the colors 
of the rainbow...!
choice_data_list:
That's the result of working as a hero, 
huh.

That's the result of working as a hero, 
you know.

This is... the bond forged by boxed 
lunches...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: ...No. I'm not the only hero.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Anyone whose heart is set on preparing a 
boxed lunch for someone else is a hero. 
There is no difference. Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just like the ingredients of a bento— each 
one shines in its own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can become someone else's bento 
box— It was a wonderful scene that allowed 
me to realize that vital truth.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. It seems there was a hidden 
power in boxed lunches that I was not yet 
aware of."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to bestow a name upon the boxed 
lunch we are about to partake in—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The World is Bento." A bento that 
connects the world... let's see.
